newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil hit hard by futures, easier premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil hit hard by futures, easier premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil was knocked sharply lower on Thursday by tumbling futures and easier premiums.
Only heating oil barges showed any sign of firmness in a thin pre-Easter market.
"There's no local interest, only export demand is keeping everything going," said one trader.
April IPE gas oil lost $5 a tonne closing at $167.00.
Heating oil barges looked a touch perkier with barges concluded at April IPE +50 cents for first half April, up 50 cents or so. But traders said the rise was modest and in a thin market.
"It's been a very quiet day overall," said one trader.
Traders said the easier tone on premiums reflected the relaxed attitude of buyers who were nearly all covered.
Russian premiums eased 50 cents or so with bids for first half April now around April IPE +50 cents and offers around +$1.50, possibly +$2.00.
FOD was also looking under a bit of pressure with offers of April +$3 cif NWE attracting very weak bids, one as low as April IPE +50 cents.
A DIN cargo traded today in an otherwise slow market and the number surprised several in the market.
